Runtime Status

The Zeo runtime provides full visibility into CLI execution, MCP server state, and resource consumption. All metrics are available locally without requiring external telemetry infrastructure.

Runtime Metrics

CLI Hot Path State

Real-time visibility into the active CLI session: current command, execution stage, and completion status.

MCP Handshake Indicator

Connection health for MCP server integration. Shows protocol version, last handshake time, and server endpoint.

Token Usage Snapshot

Per-session token consumption tracking. Input/output token counts, model selection, and budget utilization.

Command Latency

End-to-end latency measurement for CLI operations. Tracks execution time, network overhead, and processing stages.

Status Panel

Live view of CLI session state, MCP connection health, and token budget.
